EmailTemplate.description: General Case Management Template for Sun Devil Card Services
EmailTemplate.name: Case Mgmt | Sun Devil Card Services No ID Card Photo Uploaded
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Unfortunately, you have not completed the directions required to receive an ID. Please click the Submit link below to submit your ID card photo properly.
After your photo is approved, please repeat step 3.
1. Submit your photo (This is for your ID card) and approved identification to Sun Devil Card Services.https://webapp4.asu.edu/cardservices/
You will need to attach a valid, current photo ID as proof of identity. Acceptable forms of ID are US drivers’ license or state issued ID card, US visa, or a passport.
2. Wait for your photo submission approval email.
3. Once approved, choose whether you want to pick up your card or have it mailed. Fill out the appropriate form. A: Mail Request Form https://cfo.asu.edu/campus-id-card-request-form
B: Pickup Request Form https://cfo.asu.edu/webform/basic-sun-card-office-pick-form
Regards, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Sun Devil Card Services Arizona State University Phone: 480-965-2273 cardservices.asu.edu
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
